takes.sourceDescription: navigate - walk forward, backward, on a diagonal
takes.title: Walk Forward and Backward with Small Diagonal Steps
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates short forward and backward steps, turns slightly between passages, and keeps the arms relaxed near the sides.

takes.sourceDescription: navigate - walk forward, backward, on a diagonal
takes.title: Change Walking Direction with Longer Strides
takes.actionDescription: The performer shifts between forward, backward, and diagonal steps, taking several longer strides while partly side-on. They finish in a slightly bent-knee stance.

takes.sourceDescription: navigate - walk forward, backward, on a diagonal
takes.title: Walk in Several Directions and Turn Away
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates short and long steps while changing heading and direction. The final steps carry them away.

takes.sourceDescription: navigate - walk forward, backward, on a diagonal
takes.title: Alternate Diagonal Steps and Backward Walking
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates forward and backward passes with short diagonal steps and occasional bent-knee shifts. They finish in a narrow stance.

takes.sourceDescription: climb, step over, sit on, jump over stepstool
takes.title: Step Over and Sit during an Obstacle Sequence
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates high steps, forward bends, and short upright resets before continuing to step. The CMU source identifies a sequence on and around a stepstool.

takes.sourceDescription: climb, step over, jump over stepstool
takes.title: Step and Hop over a Low Obstacle
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, repeats high-knee steps and short shifts, then makes a small hop near the end. The CMU source identifies a stepstool.
